subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): metrics and logs posted to the traces endpoint when the shared OTLP endpoint is signal-qualified

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally normalize a shared OTLP endpoint that already ends in /v1/<signal> for other enabled signals, with explicit per-signal endpoints as the compatibility escape hatch?
rationale: The source path, upstream OpenTelemetry contract, tests, and loopback proof support the fix, but the fallback behavior change can affect upgraded configurations that relied on exact shared-path reuse.

options.title: Accept shared-endpoint normalization
options.body: Land this mergeable branch or the chosen canonical sibling after ordinary CI because explicit per-signal endpoints remain the compatibility path.

options.title: Require exact shared-path compatibility
options.body: Ask for a different design such as warning or skipping mismatched shared signal paths so shared endpoint reuse remains exact by default.

options.title: Use the older sibling as canonical
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98911 after it is rebased and proven mergeable.

recommendation.title: Accept shared-endpoint normalization
recommendation.body: Land this mergeable branch or the chosen canonical sibling after ordinary CI because explicit per-signal endpoints remain the compatibility path.
